# cato_cloud_interconnect_physical_connection (Resource)

Manages one manual Cloud Interconnect physical connection. Site and HA role changes require replacement. Import using the opaque connection ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The parent must be a Cloud Interconnect site with an unused HA slot.
resource "cato_cloud_interconnect_physical_connection" "example" {
  site = {
    id = "12345"
    # name = "Cloud Interconnect branch" # Use name instead of id if preferred.
  }
  ha_role = "PRIMARY"
  pop_location = {
    id = "23456"
    # name = "Interconnect PoP" # Use name instead of id if preferred.
  }
  service_provider_name = "Supported service provider"
  encapsulation_method  = "DOT1Q"
  subnet                 = "10.20.4.0/30"
  private_site_ip        = "10.20.4.1"
  private_cato_ip        = "10.20.4.2"
  upstream_bw_limit      = "100"
  downstream_bw_limit    = "100"

  # Omit tags to use API allocation; assigned active tags are returned in state.
  # Custom tags require SUPPORT_INTERCONNECT_VLAN_CONFIGURATION.
  # vlan = 123 # DOT1Q only.
  # For QINQ, set encapsulation_method = "QINQ", omit vlan, and optionally set:
  # qinq_vlan_configuration = {
  #   c_vlan = 234
  #   s_vlan = 345
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `downstream_bw_limit` (String) Downstream bandwidth as a canonical non-negative decimal integer.
- `encapsulation_method` (String) Encapsulation method. Changes require explicit replacement because the API cannot clear incompatible previous tags.
- `ha_role` (String) HA role
- `pop_location` (Attributes) PoP location (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pop_location))
- `private_cato_ip` (String) Cato IPv4 address within subnet
- `private_site_ip` (String) Site IPv4 address within subnet, distinct from the Cato address.
- `service_provider_name` (String) Service provider supported by the selected PoP
- `site` (Attributes) Parent Cloud Interconnect site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))
- `subnet` (String) Canonical IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation
- `upstream_bw_limit` (String) Upstream bandwidth as a canonical non-negative decimal integer.

### Optional

- `qinq_vlan_configuration` (Attributes) QINQ tags. Omit for API allocation; custom tags require the account feature. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qinq_vlan_configuration))
- `vlan` (Number) DOT1Q VLAN. Omit for API allocation; custom tags require the account feature.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID
